characters.name: Luca
characters.appearance: approximately 4–5 years old; boy with blond hair and blue eyes; clothing: blue T-shirt, beige shorts, white sneakers

characters.name: Max
characters.appearance: approximately 6 months old; German Shepherd puppy with black and tan fur; recurring accessories: red collar

character_actions.action:
Max vede-o frunză legănată ușor.
Luca: Mulțumesc, Max! Ce verde e decor!
Verde este frunza, verde-i iarba mea,
Verde, verde, verde — hai să spunem: da!
